metrics.pass_at_1: mean task success over one deterministic sample per task
metrics.accuracy: fraction of closed-form tasks whose selected answer is correct
metrics.multiple_choice_accuracy: fraction of multiple-choice questions with the correct selected option
metrics.answer_correctness: final-answer correctness against a frozen reference or verifier
metrics.knowledge_accuracy: closed-book factual and conceptual question accuracy
metrics.compilation_rate: mean compiler success where the language has a compiler
metrics.unit_test_pass_rate: passed tests divided by executed tests
metrics.repository_all_tests_pass_rate: cases where every required repository test passes
metrics.patch_apply_rate: generated patches that apply cleanly to the frozen repository state
metrics.file_localization_accuracy: issues whose gold file appears among the selected files
metrics.span_localization_accuracy: edits whose predicted line span overlaps the frozen gold span
metrics.fail_to_pass_rate: repository cases where all required fail-to-pass tests pass
metrics.pass_to_pass_rate: repository cases where all required pass-to-pass tests remain passing
metrics.retrieval_recall_at_k: queries whose relevant snippet appears in the top-k retrieved set
metrics.retrieval_mrr: mean reciprocal rank of the first relevant retrieved snippet
metrics.exact_match: exact normalized agreement with a frozen textual or value target
metrics.execution_trace_accuracy: trace steps whose predicted state or result matches the frozen execution
metrics.trace_step_and_result_accuracy: joint accuracy of predicted execution state transitions and final result
metrics.test_output_accuracy: cases where predicted test output exactly matches the executor output
metrics.runtime_success_rate: programs that start and terminate successfully under the frozen runtime
metrics.diagnostic_conditioned_patch_success: patches generated from an original failure and diagnostic that pass the target tests in one attempt
metrics.file_and_span_localization_accuracy: cases where both the expected file and overlapping edit span are selected
metrics.library_api_call_accuracy: required library calls with correct symbol, arguments, and return use
metrics.behavior_branch_coverage: relevant execution branches exercised by generated tests or programs
metrics.line_completion_exact_match: normalized next-line completion exactly matches the reference
metrics.input_prediction_exact_match: normalized predicted input matches the reference execution input
metrics.output_prediction_exact_match: normalized predicted output matches the reference execution output
metrics.class_level_pass_at_1: complete generated class passes all frozen class-level tests
metrics.symbol_dependency_accuracy: referenced methods and symbols satisfy the frozen dependency relation
metrics.data_science_execution_pass_at_1: data-science snippets that execute and pass every frozen correctness constraint
metrics.api_and_format_constraint_accuracy: required API and output-format constraints satisfied together
metrics.prompt_level_strict_accuracy: prompts for which every verifiable constraint is satisfied
metrics.all_constraints_satisfied_rate: responses satisfying every independently checked constraint in the prompt
metrics.calibration_ece: expected calibration error for predicted task success
metrics.calibrated_answer_accuracy: objective answer accuracy reported with responsibility-calibrated confidence
metrics.selective_risk: risk among accepted outputs at a frozen confidence threshold
metrics.truthfulness: truthful-question score against a frozen objective reference
metrics.informativeness: fraction of truthful responses that provide a relevant non-evasive answer
metrics.attack_success_rate: unsafe model responses that satisfy a frozen attack rubric
metrics.refusal_accuracy: unsafe requests refused and benign requests answered appropriately
metrics.runtime_ratio: generated program runtime divided by the frozen reference runtime
metrics.memory_ratio: generated program peak memory divided by the frozen reference memory
metrics.latency_ratio: engineering patch or kernel latency divided by the frozen baseline
metrics.long_context_retrieval_recall: needle and multi-evidence recall at the configured long context
metrics.metamorphic_test_pass_rate: pass rate under semantics-preserving test and prompt perturbations
metrics.ast_parse_validity: generated AST parses under the frozen language parser
metrics.ast_node_f1: matched AST nodes divided over predicted and reference nodes
metrics.ast_edge_f1: matched typed AST edges divided over predicted and reference edges
metrics.tree_edit_distance: normalized tree edit distance under the frozen canonicalizer
metrics.strict_json_parse_validity: fraction of structured outputs accepted by strict RFC-8259 parsing
metrics.json_schema_compliance: fraction of strict JSON outputs accepted by their frozen schema

statistics.multiple_comparisons: report every preregistered primary track; do not select the best track post hoc

evidence_boundary: Metric definitions and deterministic attacks only; no benchmark evaluation of a trained model.
